notes: Rights offering prospectus supplement (Form 424B2) dated March 11, 2021 for The Gabelli Utility Trust (NYSE: GUT). One Right per common share; seven Rights buy one new common share at a fixed $5.50 subscription price. The schema has no fixed-price field, so the $5.50 is recorded only as price_reference fixed and price_pct is null. Maximum shares 7,885,840 as stated. Record date is printed as March 11, 2020 once (Terms of the Rights Offering) and as March 11, 2021 elsewhere; 2021 is used. Expiration is April 14, 2021 unless extended; no extension is stated in this excerpt. Board may eliminate the over-subscription privilege up to the fifth day after expiration. Estimated offering expenses of about $320,000 are stated; no schema field. No arithmetic applied.
